newsitem.title: UK: IRA claims Belfast bomb, leaves seven more.
newsitem.headline: IRA claims Belfast bomb, leaves seven more.

text.p: The IRA on Monday claimed responsibility for a rocket attack on the law courts in central Belfast.
A caller to a Belfast radio station said the guerrillas have left bombs at seven locations in the city, including the main railway station aand at five hotels.
Sources at Downtown Radio station said the call with a recognised IRA identity codeword was made by a caller purporting to speak for the "Belfast Brigade" of the Irish Republican Army.
A police spokesman said they were aware of the IRA's claim. The caller named five major hotels in Belfast.
Earlier on Monday, the Republican guerrillas fired a rocket at Belfast High Court, lightly injuring two people and raising the prospect of retaliation by their pro-British Loyalist foes.
Bomb disposal squad officers combed the area and police sources said the remains of a missile had been found.
